_comment: #509 message lifecycle canonical: save status is a hint-ribbon pill (ui_save_status_rendered on game_saved) off the toast strip; a transient flavour line renders and a step dismisses it without recording (anti-spam kept); the journal modal pauses and resumes the strip; Reduce Motion changes nothing about delivery. Immediate arrival is line_display_ab (its assert_dialogue_displayed now measures OCCLUSION by the field readout); simultaneous authored/save is invrisil_hat_quiet. The 1.2s readable floor before a movement dismiss is a real-timing rule pinned by test_message_layer (QA collapses it to 0).

steps._comment: #509 SAVE STATUS: a manual save is a housekeeping toast AND a compact pill on the hint ribbon (ui_save_status_rendered) -- the pill never touches the toast strip, so it can neither delay authored copy nor be dismissed by a step.
steps.name: cancel

steps._comment: Pause rows: Resume, Save, Load, ... -- down 1 = Save.
Order is the engine's: the picker closes, the pause menu closes, THEN the slot writes (game_saved) and the ribbon pill renders, then the housekeeping toast.

MOVEMENT + RECORD: an empty interact renders a transient flavour line (not recorded -- the anti-spam constraint stays); stepping away is the ordinary dismiss. Under QA the readable floor is 0 (canonical timing untouched); the 1.2s floor itself is pinned at real timings by test_message_layer.
steps.name: move_left

steps._comment: MODAL CLOSURE (the #508 finding, now a contract): copy queued while a modal is up renders after the modal closes -- the queue is lossless. Journal open, then an authored beat cannot fire inside it, so the save status re-fires instead: pause -> save while the pill is already up re-arms it (serial) and the ribbon still reads Saved after the menu hides.
steps.name: journal

steps._comment: REDUCED MOTION: the accessibility toggle must not change delivery -- a toast still renders and the ribbon pill still fires after a save.
